title: Runtime Extra
statement: Implement `solve(deps, dev_only)`. `deps` is the full list of package names. `dev_only` is the list that must stay out of the runtime image. Return the runtime names in the original order.
hints: Build a set of the dev names.
Keep deps that are not in it.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The runtime image installs the project without the dev extra.

editorial: The runtime image installs the project without the dev extra. pytest and ruff are not needed to serve traffic, and they widen the image. Filtering them out is the install line. The lockfile still pins them for CI.
